-C.Name: -C
-C.description: Complement the set of characters in string1, that is '-C ab' includes every character except for 'a' and 'b'

-c.Name: -c
-c.description: Same as '-C' but complement the set of values in string1

-d.Name: -d
-d.description: Delete characters in string1 from the input

-s.Name: -s
-s.description: Squeeze multiple occurrences of the characters listed in the last operand (either string1 or string2) in the input into a single instance of the character. This occurs after all deletion and translation is completed

-u.Name: -u
-u.description: Guarantee that any output is unbuffered
